description: How fast a child grew between two measurements: the change, and the rate per day, per week and per 30 days. Use it for 'how many grams a day is my baby gaining' and 'how many cm did my child grow'. Weight in grams, length and head circumference in centimetres, dates as YYYY-MM-DD. It states the rate and does not compare it with a reference.

firstDate.description: Date of the earlier measurement, YYYY-MM-DD.

locale.description: Language for the disclaimer and any clinician note. Pass the language you will answer the user in: these are clinical safety texts written by a paediatrician, and they should reach the reader as written rather than translated by the model.

secondDate.description: Date of the later measurement, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: growth_velocity
title: Growth velocity between two measurements
